
Connections
API tokens allow you to programmatically access your Printify account and manage your products, orders, and stores. Use these tokens to integrate Printify with your own applications or third-party services.

Common use cases:

Build custom integrations with your existing systems
Sync products between your custom store and Printify
Automate order management and fulfillment
Learn more about the Printify API and view detailed documentation

Scopes
catalog.read
Get access to Printify Product catalog
orders.read
Get access to Printify orders
orders.write
Submit orders
print_providers.read
Read available print providers
products.read
Get access to Merchant shop products
products.write
Get access to Merchant shop product creation
shops.manage
Manage Shop in your account, e.g. install webhooks, fulfill orders, etc
shops.read
Get access to Merchant shops
uploads.read
Get access to Merchant uploaded files
uploads.write
Upload custom artwork files and archive artwork
user.info
Read user information: name, email, ID
webhooks.read
Read installed Webhooks
webhooks.write
Install, update and delete Webhooks
